correctness.rationale: Exchangeability makes the exact four-state two-patch CTMC lumpable by occupancy count with transitions 0->1 at 2c, 1->0 at e+k, 1->2 at c+d, 2->1 at 2[e+(1-rho)k], 2->0 at rho k. Solving the two balance relations and normalization gives J=2c(c+d)/D_rho and M=2c[2(c+d+e+k)-rho k]/D_rho, where D_rho=2[(c+e+k)^2+cd]-rho k(c-d+e+k) is positive at both endpoints. Exact differentiation gives M negative derivative -4cdk(c+d)/D² and J derivative 2ck(c+d)(c-d+e+k)/D². Threshold and invariance at d=c+e+k follow uniformly rho∈[0,1]. Reconstructed all symbolic stationary and derivative identities with independently written SymPy, not by executing packaged script. No claim for c=0, non-Poisson or heterogeneous networks.
